prevention.title: Lunar Base Fire Safety Insights

findings.text: ACME CFI-G observed 183 self-extinguished gas-fuel flames, the lowest at 13.5% oxygen, and 88 flames stopped by ending flow, the lowest at 15.0% oxygen.
BASS-II burned solid fuels (PMMA, Nomex, Japan wax) with measured oxygen from 13.6% to 22.2% at 101 kPa, all within Earth-cabin levels.
ACME/Flame Design mapped gas-fuel diffusion flames from 19.8% to 85.0% oxygen and 43 to 306 kPa, including a test closest to lunar conditions at 32.0% oxygen and 52 kPa.

prevention.implication: Designers must test flame suppression and detection systems at 30%+ oxygen and ≤70.3 kPa because existing data show flames persist and self-extinguish only at much lower oxygen levels.
prevention.gap: The dataset lacks partial-gravity fire data and solid-fuel tests at lunar-base oxygen (≥30%) and pressure conditions.

detection.title: Lunar Detection Data Gaps

findings.text: SAME-R recorded 109 solid-fuel rows, oxygen assumed 21.0% at 101 kPa, diluent not recorded.
SAFFIRE-III recorded 2 solid-fuel rows, oxygen assumed 21.0% at 101 kPa, tests used N2-air mixture.
SPICE recorded 435 gas-fuel rows, oxygen assumed 21.0% at 101 kPa, diluent constant across tests.

detection.implication: Designers must test detection systems at 30% oxygen or higher to ensure performance under lunar-base conditions.
detection.gap: The data do not include any partial-gravity combustion or fire-detection results.

suppression.title: Lunar Habitat Fire Suppression Insights

findings.text: FLEX observed 88 liquid-fuel rows with N2+CO2 extinguished, the lowest at 14.0% measured oxygen, and 40 rows with N2+He extinguished, the lowest at 13.0% measured oxygen.
BASS-II burned solid fuels with measured oxygen from 13.6% to 22.2%, all below the 30% oxygen expected on a lunar base.
BASS ran 121 solid-fuel rows with N2 (air) at assumed 21.0% oxygen, the nominal cabin level, under 101 kPa pressure.

suppression.implication: Designers must test and design suppression systems for 30%+ oxygen and up to 70.3 kPa to ensure extinguishment under lunar base conditions.
suppression.gap: The data lack partial-gravity results and gas-fuel extinction tests at 30% or higher oxygen levels.
